question: ______ model was followed in the first five year plan.
solution:
The correct answer is__** Harrod - Domar.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__ **

__
 
• The First Five Year Plan of India was based on the Harrod Domar Model.
 
• First Five-Year Plan of India:
 
 
• It was launched for the duration of 1951 to 1956, under the leadership of Jawaharlal Nehru.
 
• It was based on the Harrod-Domar model with a few modifications.
 
• Its main focus was on the agricultural development of the country.
 
• This plan was successful and achieved a growth rate of 3.6% (more than its target of 2.1%). 
 
• At the end of this plan, five IITs were set up in the country.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• 
 
Second Five-Year Plan (1956‑61):

 
 
• This plan was based on the P.C. Mahalanobis Model.
 
• In this plan, heavy industries and minerals were on top priority and 20.1% of the total outlay was allocated for this sector.
 
• The plan was also successful and it achieved a 4.1% rate of growth.
 
• Various important large industries like Steel Plant at Durgapur, Bhilai and Rourkela were established during this plan.
